title: Neuropathy Phenotyping Protocols - Insulin Implantation Protocol
author: Eva Feldman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7rdhm26

steps.title: Administer Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Administer intraperitoneal (i/p) injection of ketamine-HCl (Ketastet) and xylazine mix (3:1 ratio) based on animal species.

substeps.instruction: For rats (average 350g): Inject 0.3ml of undiluted mix.
For mice (average 30g): Dilute 0.1ml of mix with 0.9ml of 0.9% saline and inject 0.3ml.

steps.title: Prepare Insertion Site and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the designated insertion site (subcutaneously in dorsal skin or neck-region) and sterilize tools.

substeps.instruction: Shave, cleanse, and drench the insertion site with Betadine.
Immerse the trocar and cannula in 2% Betadine solution.

steps.title: Create Skin Orifice
steps.instruction: Create an opening in the skin for the implant.

substeps.instruction: Lift the skin between the thumb and index finger.
Pierce the skin with a 16G disposable needle and withdraw the needle.

steps.title: Insert Insulin Implant
steps.instruction: Sterilize and place the insulin implant into the subcutaneous space using the trocar.

substeps.instruction: Briefly immerse the implant in 2% Betadine solution for approximately 10 seconds.
Insert the implant into the proximal end of the trocar.
Push the trocar through the previously created skin orifice.
Use the stylet to push the implant until it exits from the distal end of the inserted trocar.

steps.title: Finalize Implantation
steps.instruction: Position the implant and treat the insertion site.

substeps.instruction: Milk the inserted implant subcutaneously away from the skin orifice.
Soak the insertion site with Betadine solution.
